Karina! Welcome to Miami. It is great to see you in person.

Start with small talk. Ask: Have you been to Brazil? Then talk about your business.
Perfect. After the event, I can keep in touch with her by email.

Good evening, everyone, and welcome to the Business Aviation Networking Night. My name is Tom, and I am the event manager. Tonight we have three hundred guests from twelve countries. Have you met the people at your table? Please say hello and make a new connection. At eight o'clock, our host, Anna Brooks, will talk about flight schools in Texas. Dinner starts at nine. And please, don't forget your business cards. Enjoy the evening!

Hi, I am Sofia, from Texas. Have you ever been nervous at a networking event? I have! Here are my three tips. First, arrive early. When the room is not full, it is easy to talk. Second, start with small talk. Ask: Have you been here before? Where are you from? Third, listen more than you talk. People remember a good listener. After the event, I always send a short message the next day to keep in touch. Last year, I met two of my best clients at events like this.
